name: Análisis de Transformada de Radon
description: Utiliza the Radon transform para detectar directional artefactos and periodic patrones indicando manipulación de imagen.
algorithm: Radon Domain Feature Extraction for Forgery Detection
mechanism: Projects image content along multiple angles using the Radon transform, creating a sinogram representation. Manipulated regions produce anomalous directional patrones in the Radon domain.
parameters: Angles: 0-179° (1° step), Projection: line integral, Domain: spatial→Radon, Feature: sinogram varianza
source: Mahdian, B. & Saic, S. (2008) — Blind Authentication Using Periodic Properties of Interpolation, IEEE TIFS
useCase: Detecting geometric manipulación and resampling through directional artefacto análisis

references.title: Mahdian, B. & Saic, S. (2008) — Blind Authentication Using Periodic Properties of Interpolation, IEEE TIFS

strengths:
• Detecta directional manipulación artefactos
• Robust to noise
• Complements dominio de frecuencia methods
• Can reveal hidden periodicity
limitations:
• Computacionalmente costoso for large images
• Limited to directional artefactos
• Requires careful parameter tuning
• May miss non-directional forgeries
